threshold_basis: story test-design NFR plan (test-design-story-web-e2e-config-hardening.md section 6) + TEA risk_threshold p1

fail_findings.description: No CI workflow exists in the worktree (no .github directory, no root .gitlab-ci.yml). None of the fail-fast env errors, the test:api:check DW-10 coverage signal, or the JUnit/HTML reporters is wired into a pipeline.

concern_findings.description: Residual silent-green window: zero-default-collection is a warning (exit 0), the default probe is skipped when BASE_URL is unset, and token-gated/skipped API suites can still pass green.
concern_findings.recommendation: Add CHECK_API_COLLECTION_STRICT=1 opt-in hard failure and assert a minimum executed-test count.

concern_findings.description: Portless BASE_URL hangs up to the 120s webServer readiness timeout before failing.
concern_findings.recommendation: Emit a fail-fast startup warning or refuse to boot the webServer unless PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_WEB_SERVER is set.

concern_findings.description: Fixed CI workers (2) / retries (2) / globalTimeout (20m) bound future suite throughput; may hit the global timeout as the e2e suite grows.
concern_findings.recommendation: Make workers/globalTimeout env-tunable or use CI-provider sharding via --shard.

decision: CONCERNS - non-blocking. The change is test-tooling-only (no production code, auth, data, or endpoints touched) and is safe to proceed/merge; aligns with the story 'done' status. The single FAIL finding (no CI workflow) is a pre-existing repo-wide gap, not introduced by this change. Recommended non-blocking follow-ups before relying on automated enforcement: (1) wire a CI pipeline exporting BASE_URL/API_URL running test:e2e, test:api, and test:api:check, (2) add DW-10 strict mode + executed-test-count assertion, (3) harden the portless-BASE_URL (DW-11) fail-fast case.
notes: Trace gate (trace workflow) remains FAIL on active acceptance coverage (P0 75%, P1 0%, overall 60%) because RED-phase scaffolds (WH-AC1, WH-P1-04) are intentionally skipped and AC-5 is only reproducible in the parent-repo harness. NFR gate is independent and non-blocking; both align that the change itself is safe, with active coverage to be locked before final story closeout.
